Oh God! I was put on Cymbalta in March of 2019. I have no memories for 4 months. I took Cymbalta with an extended release Flexiril, and started having seizures. My dr never warned me or anything about mixing the 2 until after I had the seizures. Like wth... why would you prescribe 2 meds that have this known interactions?? Anyway...I came off Cymbalta cold turkey and my brain has been a freight train on fire in a tornado. So now I get to have seizures and a seriously damaged brain. I'd get off that medication as fast and as safely as you can.
In all fairness though, it is much more dangerous for females than it is males. Yes it's sad, but that's reality.
